description: Campaign-type mapping rules for Trend-Spark AI. Maps trend signals (source, peak_window_days, keywords) to campaign_type. Drives the campaign_type field in the trends table.

HYPE.description: High-intensity, short-window trends around big movies, celeb launches, OTT releases, surprise announcements. Creates urgency.
triggers: Celebrity product launch (source: news + google_trends spike)
examples: Viral dance challenge from a new film

SEASONAL.description: Planned festivals, cultural events, seasonal celebrations. Longer windows, predictable dates. Brands prep in advance.

PRIDE.description: National pride moments: sports wins, patriotic events, Indian achievements on the global stage. Short, emotionally charged.

EDUCATIONAL.description: Evergreen health, fitness, wellness, self-improvement trends. No urgency, but builds authority and trust over time.

type_assignment_logic: 1. Check source fields: if tmdb + peak_window_days <= 3 + celeb/movie keywords → HYPE
2. Check source fields: if festival_calendar → SEASONAL (unless overridden by patriotic keywords)
3. Check keyword patterns: if patriotic/sports-win keywords → PRIDE
4. Check peak_window_days: if >= 14 + health/wellness keywords → EDUCATIONAL
5. Default fallback: if peak_window_days <= 3 → HYPE, else if <= 7 → PRIDE, else SEASONAL
notes: This JSON is read by Vikram's campaign-type assignment logic in Spring Boot.
The campaign_type field in the trends table MUST be one of: HYPE, SEASONAL, PRIDE, EDUCATIONAL.
peak_window_days is the key heuristic. Combine it with source + keyword patterns for accurate type.
n8n's theme-tagging step should also stamp campaign_type based on this rulebook before writing to trends table.
